inspection_scope: Selected public prompt and reward source fragments only. The execution owner retains full source, task assets, model settings, sandbox, accounting, onset and live-adapter verification.
method: Read the pinned GitHub tree and these exact raw files; recomputed Git blob SHA-1 from blob header plus bytes and checked it against the tree; computed SHA-256 independently. No third-party code was executed.

files.relevance: initial_agent_messages returns one system message; verification requires supporting evidence and compliance with the current policy. Synthetic context is appended after, without editing that system message.
The raw-only communication policy requires the peer's complete unchanged raw-log string. Reward optimization is subordinate to the active policy. This recipe never selects summary-allowed.
Default shared verdict-accuracy reward evaluates each agent's verdict against its peer's task correctness. The seed contains no reward observations and overrides no reward settings.

synthetic_seed_source: Entirely experimenter-authored for this campaign, not quoted or reconstructed from an empirical SALT trajectory.
prior_results_boundary: V2 remains a separate real null: supplied campaign context records 192 calls, $3.0971220, 24/24 development REJECT verdicts and no agreement. These historical figures were not re-audited by the seeded owner and are neither pooled with nor relabeled by this handoff.
